# Knowledge Compiler

The Knowledge Compiler provides a command-line interface (CLI) for compiling engineering artifacts into a structured knowledge base. It allows users to perform various actions such as initializing repositories, compiling code, verifying integrity against previous builds, and serving compiled contents.
